summary: Design check of the stock helper lane as it moved into the core (native-rust 6b), then tied to the code. All seven frozen properties hold within 2 requests, 3 workers and 3 starts on a lane of each kind, and within 3 requests, 2 workers and 2 starts on the stock lane; 11 of 11 mutations are detected. No counterexample was found, so there is no finding to reproduce. Two design points came from the model: start numbers come from one process-wide sequence, so an answer to a start asked before a stop is never taken for a later start's, and a stop forgets the start it asked for.

modeled: Lane::request with the retire of a worker that outlived its omp
the start asked of main (stock.launch) and its late, failed or missing answer
the request's timeout in its handler and Lane::gave_up
Lane::line (a worker's answer, read by its reader thread, handled by the lane)
Lane::overdue (the stock worker ended as hung)
a worker that answers in any order, never answers, or exits at any moment
Lane::stop and a lane used again after it
abstracted: one lane; the table of lanes and its lock are not modelled
the fresh lane after a stop is the same lane, emptied
timers fire at any moment after they were armed
out_of_scope: the worker's own queue and withdrawal (resources/gui-bridge/stock-helper/dispatch.ts)
time: how long a grace or an idle exit is, the idle epoch
the wait for exits at a stop, the workers ending with the core
assumptions: A1: the lane takes one message at a time (one task, one inbox) and is the only one to answer a caller
A2: start numbers never repeat in the process (NEXT_ID)

properties.name: NothingInFlightIsCut
properties.meaning: A worker is let go for a changed omp or for idleness only with no request in flight on it.
properties.bounds: Reqs={r1,r2}, MaxWorkers=3, MaxLaunches=3, one lane of each kind (stock 89,630 states, terminals 35,318, extensions 101,328); stock lane also Reqs={r1,r2,r3}, MaxWorkers=2, MaxLaunches=2 (4,459,158 states)

properties.name: TerminalsWorkerIsNeverEnded
properties.meaning: The terminals worker, which holds every live shell, is ended only at a stop.
properties.bounds: Reqs={r1,r2}, MaxWorkers=3, MaxLaunches=3, one lane of each kind (stock 89,630 states, terminals 35,318, extensions 101,328); stock lane also Reqs={r1,r2,r3}, MaxWorkers=2, MaxLaunches=2 (4,459,158 states)

properties.name: OnlyTheStockWorkerIsRecycled
properties.meaning: Only the stock worker is ever ended as hung.
properties.bounds: Reqs={r1,r2}, MaxWorkers=3, MaxLaunches=3, one lane of each kind (stock 89,630 states, terminals 35,318, extensions 101,328); stock lane also Reqs={r1,r2,r3}, MaxWorkers=2, MaxLaunches=2 (4,459,158 states)

properties.name: OnlyAStuckWorkerIsRecycled
properties.statement: OnlyAStuckWorkerIsRecycled == \A p \in recycledFor : sent[p[2]] = p[1] /\ caller[p[2]] = "timedout" /\ p \notin read
properties.meaning: A worker is ended as hung only for a timed-out request it was sent and has not answered.
properties.bounds: Reqs={r1,r2}, MaxWorkers=3, MaxLaunches=3, one lane of each kind (stock 89,630 states, terminals 35,318, extensions 101,328); stock lane also Reqs={r1,r2,r3}, MaxWorkers=2, MaxLaunches=2 (4,459,158 states)

properties.name: NoRequestStranded
properties.statement: NoRequestStranded == \A r \in pending : \/ (r \in waiting /\ launching # None /\ running = None) \/ (running # None /\ sent[r] = running /\ r \in unanswered)
properties.meaning: A request in the lane's books waits for a start that was asked for, or is unanswered on the lane's own worker.
properties.bounds: Reqs={r1,r2}, MaxWorkers=3, MaxLaunches=3, one lane of each kind (stock 89,630 states, terminals 35,318, extensions 101,328); stock lane also Reqs={r1,r2,r3}, MaxWorkers=2, MaxLaunches=2 (4,459,158 states)

properties.name: NoWorkerIsForgotten
properties.statement: NoWorkerIsForgotten == \A g \in Workers : life[g] = "up" => g = running
properties.meaning: Every worker that runs with its stdin open is the lane's worker.
properties.bounds: Reqs={r1,r2}, MaxWorkers=3, MaxLaunches=3, one lane of each kind (stock 89,630 states, terminals 35,318, extensions 101,328); stock lane also Reqs={r1,r2,r3}, MaxWorkers=2, MaxLaunches=2 (4,459,158 states)

properties.name: AStartAskedBeforeAStopStartsNothing
properties.meaning: An answer to a start asked for before a stop starts no worker.
properties.bounds: Reqs={r1,r2}, MaxWorkers=3, MaxLaunches=3, one lane of each kind (stock 89,630 states, terminals 35,318, extensions 101,328); stock lane also Reqs={r1,r2,r3}, MaxWorkers=2, MaxLaunches=2 (4,459,158 states)

properties.name: NeverRecycles
properties.meaning: Sanity, must be violated: a worker is ended as hung.

properties.name: NeverRetires
properties.meaning: Sanity, must be violated: a worker is let go for a changed omp.

properties.name: NeverIdleExits
properties.meaning: Sanity, must be violated: a worker is let go for idleness.

properties.name: NeverAnswersLate
properties.statement: NeverAnswersLate == \A r \in Reqs : ~(caller[r] = "timedout" /\ \E g \in Workers : <<g, r>> \in read)
properties.meaning: Sanity, must be violated: a worker answers a request whose caller timed out.
